mapper.select: /* GpsEncBackfillMapper.selectAttdGpsTargets */ SELECT G.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , G.GPS_ID AS rowKey , G.LAT AS lat , G.LON AS lon FROM TB_USER_ATTD_GPS G WHERE G.LAT_ENC IS NULL AND G.LAT IS NOT NULL AND G.LON IS NOT NULL

/* GpsEncBackfillMapper.selectTbmAttendanceTargets */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.ATTENDANCE_CD AS rowKey , A.ENTRY_GPS_LAT AS lat , A.ENTRY_GPS_LON AS lon FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE A WHERE A.ENTRY_GPS_LAT_ENC IS NULL AND A.ENTRY_GPS_LAT IS NOT NULL AND A.ENTRY_GPS_LON IS NOT NULL

/* GpsEncBackfillMapper.selectTbmSessionTargets */ SELECT S.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , S.SESSION_CD AS rowKey , S.MANAGER_GPS_LAT AS lat , S.MANAGER_GPS_LON AS lon FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.MANAGER_GPS_LAT_ENC IS NULL AND S.MANAGER_GPS_LAT IS NOT NULL AND S.MANAGER_GPS_LON IS NOT NULL
